extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Neighbourhood places and their purposes — school for learning, hospital for sickness, park for playing, market for buying, post office for mail, police station for safety. (2) Land features — hills are high, plains are flat, valleys are low between hills. (3) Water bodies — rivers have flowing water that moves, ponds have still water that stays. Misconceptions: 'all water is the same' (rivers flow, ponds are still), 'hills and plains are the same' (hills are high, plains are flat), 'we go to hospital to play' (hospital is for sickness, park is for play). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function NeighbourhoodGame), NOT export default. Export interface NeighbourhoodGameProps with onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
